title: Power Stack Watchlist
method: Action-oriented queue combining business quality, plausible upside, downside/funding risk, valuation, technical location, current theme significance and portfolio overlap. Structural quality and buy-now quality are separate. Social/congressional/insider activity can trigger or strengthen research attention but does not substitute for operating evidence. Names without a fresh executable quote explicitly require price refresh before action.
marketRegime: Direct Iran-US-Houthi escalation has pushed Middle East products/shipping risk to the top of the stack while CAISO and Malaysia heat independently validate peak-load, grid and cooling scarcity. At the same time, record AI-linked debt supply and a restrictive long end raise the hurdle for leverage-dependent duration. Prefer existing generation, regulated/contracted grid exposure, funded backlog, pricing power and cash conversion; do not chase beneficiaries that have already moved beyond prior entry zones.

buckets.label: Buy / Accumulate
buckets.description: Price, business quality and current theme setup are aligned enough for staged entry.

buckets.label: Selective / Retest
buckets.description: Good business/theme, but current price, tactical macro risk or portfolio overlap requires a better level or confirmation.

buckets.label: Wait / Confirm
buckets.description: Interesting exposure, but current risk/reward or cyclical timing is not strong enough to force.

buckets.label: Avoid / High Risk
buckets.description: Theme may be attractive, but financing, valuation, dilution or execution risk currently dominates.

candidates.name: Cameco
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$92 or deterioration in contracting / mine / Westinghouse evidence
candidates.thesis: Best current immediate entry among high-quality scarcity names. Prefer operating uranium/fuel and Westinghouse exposure over pre-revenue reactor hype.

candidates.name: Vistra
candidates.action: TOP-TIER RETEST WATCH / DO NOT CHASE
candidates.entry: $140–145 preferred; $145–148 acceptable only if support forms
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$132 or deterioration in hedge coverage, 2027 EBITDA opportunity, Meta/Helix contracted-power economics or generation availability
candidates.theme: Power generation · nuclear/gas · CAISO peak-load · AI electricity scarcity
candidates.thesis: California heat is now a direct operating relevance signal rather than a generic grid story: Vistra's West fleet includes Moss Landing gas generation plus other CAISO capacity. CAISO issued a Sep 9 Flex Alert and EEA1 as air-conditioning demand rises into the solar drop-off window. Existing signed Meta/AWS PPAs and Helix funded infrastructure still provide better load quality than speculative data-centre queues. Q2 Ongoing Operations Adjusted EBITDA rose more than 30% YoY and 2026 guidance was reaffirmed. Stronger thesis, worse chase risk after six straight gains into $151.72.

candidates.name: Eaton
candidates.action: THESIS STRONGER / WAIT RETEST — DO NOT CHASE
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$388 or material electrical-order/backlog deterioration
candidates.theme: Electrical equipment · data centres · switchgear · grid resilience
candidates.thesis: Peak-load stress and real data-centre demand strengthen switchgear/electrical scarcity, while the AI-credit story increases the value of funded backlog. The stock has already moved well above the old $388–395 support-entry zone, so the action becomes more selective even as the business thesis improves.

candidates.name: Valmont Industries
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$440 or weakening infrastructure/agriculture orders
candidates.thesis: Grid reliability, transmission hardening and cooling/water constraints strengthen the crossover thesis. Retains useful diversification versus pure AI-power names.

candidates.name: Tenaga Nasional
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <RM13.00 or material weakening in regulated grid capex / data-centre connection economics
candidates.theme: Malaysia grid · regulated transmission/distribution · data-centre power
candidates.thesis: The Malaysia power thesis has moved from forecast to observed load. Data centres reached a record 9.3% of electricity consumption during August heat versus a 7% 2026 average, while PETRA says TNB supplied 36 operating data centres with about 4.5GW planned capacity through 1Q26 and 23 projects under construction with 3.8GW maximum demand. This is a lower-duration, regulated way to own the grid buildout; staged entry only because the stock is not at a distressed level.

candidates.name: CF Industries
candidates.action: WAIT FOR RETEST / DO NOT CHASE
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$118 or sharp collapse in nitrogen margins / US gas advantage
candidates.thesis: Hormuz and Gulf infrastructure risk strengthen fertilizer/feedstock trade-flow concerns, but price strength worsens immediate asymmetry. Quality high; no chase.

candidates.name: Corteva
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$78 or weakening seed pricing / separation economics
candidates.thesis: Highest-quality agriculture compounder and value-unlock catalyst, but price is near the 52-week high after confirming above $86–87.

candidates.name: NCR Voyix
candidates.entry: Prefer $8.00–8.50; current area only as a small starter
candidates.confirmation: Q3/Q4 FCF delivery + recurring/RCV growth; price >~$9.50
candidates.invalidation: 2026 FCF guidance cut, recurring revenue/RCV deterioration, leverage rises materially or sustained <$7
candidates.theme: Corporate simplification · recurring commerce software · cash-flow inflection
candidates.thesis: Q2 recurring revenue was $435m, Commerce Platform remaining contract value reached $286m (+65% YoY), and management maintained $190–220m adjusted FCF-unrestricted before restructuring guidance. Attractive asymmetry is offset by leverage and slow pro-forma growth; the stronger long-end/credit regime makes FCF delivery more important.

candidates.name: Quanta Services
candidates.action: BREAKOUT STRENGTH / WAIT RETEST — DO NOT CHASE
candidates.invalidation: Sustained break below ~$580 with backlog/order deterioration
candidates.thesis: Record backlog/RPO and real grid awards remain exactly what the current regime rewards. California/Malaysia peak-load evidence strengthens the structural need, but price has already moved from the old $590–610 entry toward the prior stronger confirmation area. Strong thesis, weaker buy-now asymmetry.

candidates.name: MN Holdings
candidates.action: PROMOTED / WAIT RETEST — DO NOT CHASE
candidates.invalidation: Sustained <RM3.20 or material order-book/execution/cash-conversion deterioration
candidates.theme: Substations · grid interconnection · data centres · utilities
candidates.thesis: Company-specific evidence now matches the macro thesis: FY26 revenue rose about 61% and net profit nearly doubled, while the order book stood around RM1.64bn with substation engineering the main growth driver. Malaysia's observed data-centre cooling load and expected grid/generation expansion strengthen future tender demand. Price is near the recent high, so research priority rises faster than buy-now attractiveness.

candidates.invalidation: Sustained <$200 or ARR/net-new-ARR/FCF deterioration
candidates.thesis: Mission-critical cyber remains durable, but oil/rates and AI-capital competition keep the valuation hurdle high. Falling price is not by itself a buy signal.
